reason: This PR changes core optimizer behavior by limiting projection pushdown scope in `pkg/planner/core/exhaust_physical_plans.go`, with supporting logic in shared expression utilities. That is a central planner/expression semantic path: it can change plan shapes broadly, affect query performance globally, and potentially introduce correctness regressions around projection/pushdown handling. Despite the small diff, the blast radius is high enough to justify a 20-40 minute deep review.
